source-integrity.tradability: validated by current Workgraph identity record
source-integrity.provenance: SEC Q2 2026 and registration-risk disclosure supplement issuer milestone releases; government concentration is sourced to regulatory filing rather than inferred.
source-integrity.freshness: Q2 2026 SEC evidence dated 2026-08-18; commercialization releases through 2026-09-14; Scout assist regulatory concentration evidence persisted 2026-09-29.
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: Issuer technical claims are not treated as independently verified; regulatory disclosures provide separate risk/financial evidence.

company-underwriting.thesis: Infleqtion has strategically relevant neutral-atom quantum computing, sensing and timing capabilities with rapid early commercialization signals and strong government validation, but revenue remains small, losses are large and customer concentration/technical scaling make the thesis highly execution-dependent.
company-underwriting.keyRisk: Technical milestones may not become economic quantum advantage or scalable commercial revenue, while historically high government-customer concentration exposes results to appropriations and award cycles.
company-underwriting.nextCatalyst: Independent validation of the targeted logical-qubit milestones and evidence that 2026 deployments convert into repeatable commercial revenue with reduced customer concentration.

thesisQuality.basis: Quantum computing, sensing and timing address real strategic needs and have government/partner validation, but utility-scale economic advantage remains forward-looking.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 disclosures show rapid growth and liquidity but operating losses substantially exceed revenue; government concentration adds revenue-quality risk.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Commercialization remains early and loss-making, so current primary evidence cannot support strong dilution-adjusted valuation asymmetry despite technology optionality.

catalystScore.basis: Logical-qubit roadmap, NVIDIA CUDA-Q work, Cisco networked-quantum collaboration and government deployments create multiple identifiable technical/commercial checkpoints.

governancePower.basis: Regulatory disclosure improves transparency, but revenue-recognition updates and early-stage commercialization warrant a mixed governance/execution assessment rather than assuming mature controls.

alignment2036.basis: Neutral-atom quantum compute, precision timing/sensing and resilient navigation are foundational capabilities across defense, infrastructure and advanced computing futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Core neutral-atom/control capabilities span computing, sensing, timing and networked quantum applications, creating several demand paths from one technology base.

bottleneckControl.basis: Specialized neutral-atom control and quantum engineering are scarce capabilities, but competing quantum modalities and unresolved error-correction/scaling bottlenecks prevent stronger control.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Government and commercial applications provide optionality, but historical 73% combined U.S./UK government revenue concentration and technical scaling dependence create substantial scenario exposure.

substitutionResilience.basis: Neutral-atom architecture has differentiated attributes, but ion, superconducting, photonic and other quantum approaches remain credible substitutes while economic advantage is unproven.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Regulatory disclosure identifies specialized-talent constraints and the platform depends on specialized hardware; evidence does not establish robust redundant supply architecture.

pricingPower.basis: Government awards and early deployments demonstrate willingness to fund capability, but repeatable commercial pricing power and normalized margins are not yet established.

riskEvidence.basis: Large operating losses, technical scaling uncertainty, government-customer concentration, appropriations exposure and specialized-talent constraints are material; liquidity and multiple technical paths partly offset them.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: SEC financial/risk disclosures and multiple current primary technical sources provide useful coverage, but technical claims lack broad independent verification and commercial economics remain immature.
